question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Veracity**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Falsehood**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Veracity"** refers to the quality of being truthful, honest, or accurate. (सत्यता)
 
 
• **Example:** The veracity of her statement was confirmed by the evidence she provided.
 
 
• The word **"Falsehood"** is the direct opposite of veracity. It means the state of being untrue or the act of telling lies. (असत्यता)
 
 
• **Example:** The politician's speech was filled with falsehoods, which were later exposed by the media.
